title: Golfing the Kingdom of Wonder 10 Day Itinerary
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The "Kingdom of Wonder" 10-day itinerary features 3 primary regions: Phnom Penh (Days 1–3 playing Vattanac East & West), The Southern Coast (Kep & Kampot, Days 4–5), and Siem Reap (Days 6–10 playing Angkor Golf Resort and Phokeethra Country Club).
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

**Golfing the 'Kingdom of Wonder': A 10-Day Elite Itinerary**

**Focus:** _Curating the Ultimate Multi-City Golf and Heritage Experience._

**The "Kingdom of Wonder" Itinerary at a Glance**

| Days | Primary Location | Featured Golf Course | Cultural/Luxury Highlight | 
|---|---|---|---|
| 1-3 | Phnom Penh | Vattanac Golf Resort (East) | Sunset at Sora Sky Bar; Royal Palace Tour. | 
| 4-5 | The Coast (Kep) | Day Trip / Wellness | Kampot Pepper Estate; Luxury Seafood Dining. | 
| 6-8 | Siem Reap | Angkor Golf Resort | Private Sunrise at [Angkor Wat](https://whc.unesco.org/); Apsara Dance. | 
| 9-10 | Siem Reap | Phokeethra Country Club | Helicopter to Koh Ker; Farewell Banquet. | 

How does one balance the pursuit of the perfect swing with the exploration of one of the world’s most significant historical landscapes? In 2026, the **refined traveler** demands an itinerary that offers variety, exclusivity, and a seamless flow between high-performance sport and deep cultural immersion. At **Asia Golf Specialists**, we have perfected the "10-Day Grand Tour," a meticulously paced journey that showcases the absolute best of Cambodia’s modern luxury and ancient majesty.

**Phnom Penh: The Metropolitan Start**

The journey begins in the revitalized capital of Phnom Penh. Upon your VVIP arrival, you are transferred to the **Rosewood Phnom Penh**, occupying the upper floors of the iconic Vattanac Capital Tower. Days one and two are dedicated to the **Vattanac Golf Resort**. We recommend starting with the **East Course** to appreciate its cultural iconography, followed by the **West Course** the next day to test your technical skills. Evenings are spent in the city's burgeoning fine-dining scene, with a mandatory sunset cocktail at **Sora Sky Bar** to take in the 360-degree views of the Mekong and Tonle Sap rivers.

**The Southern Detour: Culinary and Coastal Restoration**

Before heading north, a brief detour to the south provides a change of pace. A private chauffeured transfer takes you toward the coastal town of Kep. While there are no championship courses here yet, the "wellness" and "culinary" value is immense. You will visit a premier **Kampot Pepper** estate for a private lunch, followed by an afternoon of seafood at the historic Kep Crab Market. Staying at a boutique luxury villa like **Knai Bang Chatt**, you can enjoy the sea breeze and a traditional Khmer massage, resetting your body for the second half of the tour.

**Siem Reap: The Spiritual and Sporting Heart**

The final leg of the tour is a short flight to Siem Reap. This is where the golf and heritage truly converge. Day six features the **Angkor Golf Resort**, [Sir Nick Faldo](https://nickfaldodesign.com/)’s masterpiece, where the fairways are as immaculate as the service. On day seven, we pause the golf for a "Cultural Deep-Dive." We arrange for a private, early-access tour of **Angkor Wat**, led by a leading archaeologist, followed by a champagne breakfast in a secluded spot away from the crowds.

The tour reaches its crescendo with a round at **Phokeethra Country Club**, managed by Sofitel, offering a classic championship layout that has hosted the Asian Tour. For the ultimate finale, we charter a private helicopter to the remote jungle temple of **Koh Ker**, where a sunset dinner is served amidst the ruins. This 10-day itinerary isn't just a trip; it’s a narrative arc that leaves the refined traveler with a profound understanding of Cambodia’s past and a deep appreciation for its sporting future.

_Your 10-day masterpiece is ready to be played._ **_Contact our Team to enquire about our full 2026 "Kingdom of Wonder" Itinerary and let Asia Golf Specialists customize every detail to your preference._**

faqs.q: Which championship golf courses are included in the 10-day Kingdom of Wonder Cambodia itinerary?
faqs.a: The 10-day itinerary features four marquee rounds across two cities: Sir Nick Faldo's Vattanac Golf Resort (East and West Courses) in Phnom Penh, followed by Faldo's Angkor Golf Resort and Sofitel's Phokeethra Country Club in Siem Reap.

faqs.q: How do groups travel between Phnom Penh, Kep, and Siem Reap on this 10-day tour?
faqs.a: Groups travel from Phnom Penh to Kep via private chauffeured luxury MPV (2.5 hours with a stop at La Plantation Kampot Pepper estate), then transfer to Phnom Penh Techo Airport for a 45-minute domestic flight to Siem Reap Angkor International Airport (SAI).

faqs.q: Which five-star hotels anchor the Phnom Penh, Kep, and Siem Reap legs?
faqs.a: We pair Rosewood Phnom Penh or Raffles Hotel Le Royal in the capital with Knai Bang Chatt on the Kep coast, concluding at Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor, Amansara, or Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang in Siem Reap.

description: 10-day luxury Cambodia golf itinerary pairing Vattanac Golf Resort in Phnom Penh, a Kep coastal culinary retreat, and Angkor Golf Resort in Siem Reap.
